title: Growth Items
html:
Growth Items are rainbow rings and amulets with a + % Character Size bonus. Size does nothing in a fight. Players stacked two rings and one amulet; the old listed maximum is 56% (13% + 13% + 26%). The jewelry prefix for that bonus is Up-Sized.
